model_selection: none; Phase 6 VAR hyperparameters frozen before this run

oxygen.interpretation: constant environmental condition, not targeted neuronal stimulation

split: chronological 2/3 train, 1/6 validation, purge 12, remainder test

frozen_phase5_var_reason: Phase 5/6 VAR checkpoints are tied to each NoStim worm's ordered 103-127-dimensional trace panel; external worms have different panels and trace-level multi-labels. No valid frozen-transfer comparison exists.
comparison_to_phase6: Descriptive only. Phase 6 used five different NoStim sessions, a blocked split and a reused test block; these are unpaired observations from different animals.
limitations: Seven recording sessions; animal independence is not proven by OSF metadata.
Constant-oxygen first half only; no oxygen-response or sensory-input test was run.
Behaviour labels are inferred from calcium signals, not independent behaviour.
Different coarse behaviour vocabulary and trace panels from NoStim.
Small n; bootstrap interval is descriptive and does not rescue a failed effect.
